description: The card's gateway and engine, from the names of docs/metrics.md alone. Times are the gateway's or vLLM's, never the reader's. README, "Monitoring".

panels.title: Service status
panels.description: The status of /v1/state, from the gateway's metrics. "Not reached": no tunnel, or no card.

panels.title: Scrapes
panels.description: Whether the last scrape of each job succeeded. Both fail whenever no tunnel runs: a card that is not rented or not reached, which is not an alert. The engine's fails alone while vLLM's /metrics does not answer within 5 s and 8 MB, and while the engine starts.

panels.title: Idle interval left
panels.description: Seconds until the service falls asleep without work of ours (contract section 8): the idle interval less the idle time. Work of reader, agent or internal in flight holds it at the full interval; outside keys and scrapes hold nothing.

panels.title: Work of ours in flight
panels.description: Requests of reader, agent and internal between their authorization and their end: what holds the card awake.

panels.title: Sleep and drain
panels.description: Whether a sleep has begun (the instance is being stopped), and the drain generation of /v1/state. A planned drain or sleep is not an alert.

panels.title: Gateway started
panels.description: When the gateway process started: a new value is a new boot, whose counters start at 0.

panels.title: Alerts firing
panels.description: The rules of monitoring/prometheus/rules.yml that fire now. No notifier is set up; http://127.0.0.1:9090/alerts has the details.

panels.title: Selected gateway outcomes; text generation and count breakdowns
Generations by outcome
panels.description: Generations by outcome, each counted once at its end, per interval of the graph. A stream that failed after its 200 is an engine_error, not a success. Outcomes and codes: docs/metrics.md.

panels.title: Counts by outcome
panels.description: Counts by outcome, each counted once at its end, per interval of the graph. A stream that failed after its 200 is an engine_error, not a success. Outcomes and codes: docs/metrics.md.

panels.title: Not a success, over the range
panels.description: Generations and counts that did not succeed, over the dashboard's whole range, by route, class, outcome and code. Class none: refused before its class was known.

panels.title: HTTP statuses, over the range
panels.description: Every request on both listeners by the HTTP status sent, a separate counter from the outcomes: here a stream that failed after its 200 is a 200. Scrapes are the control listener's /metrics and /metrics/engine.

panels.title: Tokens per second, by class
panels.description: Input and output tokens of generations whose engine stream ended well, reasoning included in the output, from the gateway's counters.

panels.title: Over the range
panels.description: Over the dashboard's whole range: the share of input tokens the engine read from its prefix cache, and the generations whose prompt_tokens from the engine differed from the gateway's count (contract section 5).

panels.title: Generation places: active and waiting ($class)
panels.description: Generations the gateway has sent to the engine (active) and generations waiting in the gateway for a place (waiting), with each class's caps of contract section 7, dashed. This queue is the gateway's, not vLLM's.

panels.title: Count places: active and waiting
panels.description: Counts in a count place and counts waiting for one, a generation's count stage included, all classes, with the count places of contract section 5, dashed. This queue is the gateway's.

panels.title: Accepted, shared places and work of ours
panels.description: Accepted generations and counts not answered yet (what a drain waits for), the generations of agent, internal and external in their shared places against the shared cap, dashed, and requests of ours in flight (what holds the card awake).

panels.title: Text gateway times, not what the reader sees
Wait for a count place ($class)
panels.description: From entering the count stage to a count place, for counts and for generations' count stages. The gateway's time from acceptance, once the body has arrived and passed its checks: not what the reader sees, who also waits for Telegram, the bot, the tunnel and the upload before it, and for the way back after it. The bars on the right axis are the observations each percentile comes from, over the same window: a percentile of a handful says little. Percentiles are estimated within the histogram's buckets (docs/metrics.md).

panels.title: Count ($class)
panels.description: The engine's count of the input, once it has a count place. The gateway's time from acceptance, once the body has arrived and passed its checks: not what the reader sees, who also waits for Telegram, the bot, the tunnel and the upload before it, and for the way back after it. The bars on the right axis are the observations each percentile comes from, over the same window: a percentile of a handful says little. Percentiles are estimated within the histogram's buckets (docs/metrics.md).

panels.title: Wait for a generation place ($class)
panels.description: From asking for a generation place, after the count and the input's checks, to having one: the gateway's own queue. The gateway's time from acceptance, once the body has arrived and passed its checks: not what the reader sees, who also waits for Telegram, the bot, the tunnel and the upload before it, and for the way back after it. The bars on the right axis are the observations each percentile comes from, over the same window: a percentile of a handful says little. Percentiles are estimated within the histogram's buckets (docs/metrics.md).

panels.title: Whole wait, wait_ms ($class)
panels.description: From acceptance to a generation place, when the gateway sends the generation to vLLM: the count stage and the wait for a place. The gateway's time from acceptance, once the body has arrived and passed its checks: not what the reader sees, who also waits for Telegram, the bot, the tunnel and the upload before it, and for the way back after it. The bars on the right axis are the observations each percentile comes from, over the same window: a percentile of a handful says little. Percentiles are estimated within the histogram's buckets (docs/metrics.md).

panels.title: First token, first_token_ms ($class)
panels.description: From acceptance to the first token received from vLLM, reasoning included, which the reader does not see. Observed only when a token arrived: a stream without one, a cancellation or an error adds nothing here. The gateway's time from acceptance, once the body has arrived and passed its checks: not what the reader sees, who also waits for Telegram, the bot, the tunnel and the upload before it, and for the way back after it. The bars on the right axis are the observations each percentile comes from, over the same window: a percentile of a handful says little. Percentiles are estimated within the histogram's buckets (docs/metrics.md).

panels.title: Total, total_ms ($class)
panels.description: From acceptance to the end of vLLM's stream, for streams that ended well. The gateway's time from acceptance, once the body has arrived and passed its checks: not what the reader sees, who also waits for Telegram, the bot, the tunnel and the upload before it, and for the way back after it. The bars on the right axis are the observations each percentile comes from, over the same window: a percentile of a handful says little. Percentiles are estimated within the histogram's buckets (docs/metrics.md).

panels.title: The gateway's times over the whole range ($class)
panels.description: Percentiles over the dashboard's whole range, each with the observations it comes from. The gateway's time from acceptance, once the body has arrived and passed its checks: not what the reader sees, who also waits for Telegram, the bot, the tunnel and the upload before it, and for the way back after it.

panels.title: Engine: vLLM's own metrics, relayed at /metrics/engine
vLLM: running and waiting
panels.description: Requests in vLLM's running batches and in vLLM's own waiting queue, by reason: capacity waits for room in the batch or the KV cache. This queue is vLLM's, behind the gateway's; a generation in it already holds a gateway place.

panels.title: vLLM: KV cache and preemptions
panels.description: The share of the KV cache in use, and preemptions per interval: requests the scheduler took out of the batch for lack of KV cache.

panels.title: Prefix cache
panels.description: The share of looked-up tokens vLLM found in its prefix cache, and the share of the gateway's input tokens vLLM said it read from the cache.

panels.title: vLLM: queue time and first token
panels.description: vLLM's own times, from when vLLM's server took the request, after the gateway's wait: its queue and its time to first token, at the 90th percentile. The bars on the right axis are the observations each percentile comes from, over the same window: a percentile of a handful says little. Percentiles are estimated within the histogram's buckets (docs/metrics.md).

panels.title: vLLM: tokens per second
panels.description: Prefill and generated tokens per second, all requests.

panels.title: Drafted tokens accepted
panels.description: The multi-token prediction: the share of drafted tokens accepted, and the mean acceptance length, the tokens each step yields (right axis). Empty while the drafter is off.

panels.title: Machine: the card's host and GPU (optional exporters, not installed)
GPU utilization and memory
panels.description: The GPU's utilization and the share of its memory in use. Empty until node_exporter and nvidia_gpu_exporter run on the card and the tunnel forwards them (README, "Monitoring"); the jobs are commented out in prometheus.yml.

panels.title: GPU temperature and power
panels.description: The GPU's temperature and power draw (right axis). Empty until node_exporter and nvidia_gpu_exporter run on the card and the tunnel forwards them (README, "Monitoring"); the jobs are commented out in prometheus.yml.

panels.title: CPU, memory and disk
panels.description: The host's CPU busy share and memory in use (in a rented container, the host's as the kernel reports them), and the root filesystem's use. Empty until node_exporter and nvidia_gpu_exporter run on the card and the tunnel forwards them (README, "Monitoring"); the jobs are commented out in prometheus.yml.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Bytes a second through the host's interfaces but loopback. Empty until node_exporter and nvidia_gpu_exporter run on the card and the tunnel forwards them (README, "Monitoring"); the jobs are commented out in prometheus.yml.

panels.title: Selected gateway: all operation outcomes
panels.description: One outcome per completed operation. Pictures include submissions, stops, uploads and input storage; text includes generation and count.

panels.title: Picture jobs known to the gateway
panels.description: Known jobs only, not the entire ComfyUI queue. Active: drawing/over. Waiting: preparing/submitting/pending. Unresolved stops are separate; the cap covers all held jobs.

list.label: class
list.description: The classes of the gateway's times and generation places.
